source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p5
s: Which of the following Chalukya inscriptions mentions Kakatiya founder?
x: The Mangallu inscription of the Eastern Chalukya king Danarnava mentions the Kakatiya progenitor. This is confirmed by the Bayyaram inscription of Mylamba.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p5
s: Who translated the Brahmo Samaj texts into Tamil and Telugu languages?
x: Sridharlu Naidu, a member of Brahmo Samaj, translated Brahmo Samaj texts into Tamil and Telugu. In 1864 Keshav Chandra Sen and Sridharlu Naidu founded the Veda Samaj in Madras.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p5
s: Find the correct pair among the following?
x: Tilapisakas - oil extractors (Ganuga), Kolikals - weavers (Saale), Kularika - potter, Vadhikulu - carpenter.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p5
s: Which dynasty came to the throne after the first invasion in the history of Vijayanagara?
x: The first usurpation (1485) ended the Sangama dynasty and brought the Saluva dynasty to the throne. The second (1505) replaced the Saluvas with the Tuluvas.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p5
s: Identify the incorrect pair among the following?
x: Caesar Frederick visited Vijayanagara in 1565 at the time of the battle of Rakshasa Tangadi/Talikota, while Venkatapati Raya-II ruled from 1585-1614.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p5
s: Which of the following scriptures is considered authoritative in the administration of justice during the Vijayanagara period?
x: Parasara Madhaviyam mentions four types of courts depending on the members. The Raya was the supreme magistrate, assisted by Pradvivakas.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p5
s: Crescent newspaper was started by?
x: Crescent newspaper was started in 1844 by Gajula Lakshminarasushetti. It was an English weekly that mainly published peasant issues.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p5
s: Who was the zamindar defeated in the battle of Padmanabha?
x: Chinna Vijayaramaraju rebelled against the British when they removed him from the zamindari, and was killed in the Battle of Padmanabham on 10 July 1794.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p5
s: During whose period the employees built the Lepakshi temple?
x: Lepakshi temple was built by Penugonda Virupanna during the reign of Achyuta Devaraya.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p5
s: Who among the following Chola emperors gave his daughter to Chalukya Vimaladitya?
x: When Jata Choda Bhima invaded Vengi, Shaktivarma and Vimaladitya fled to the Chola kingdom. Vimaladitya married Kundava, the daughter of Raja Raja.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p5
s: Among the Vengi Chalukya rulers in Andhra, who built many temples?
x: Chalukya Bhima-I built various temples including the Pancharamas, such as the Bhimeswara temples at Chalukya Bhimavaram (Samarlakota) and Draksharamam.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p5
s: Andhra person who served as Vice Chancellor of Madras University?
x: Raghupathi Venkataratnam Naidu was appointed the first Telugu Vice Chancellor of Madras University in 1925-28.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p5
s: The military administration of Vijayanagara period was called?
x: The Siddha sainyam of the Vijayanagara army was overseen by the Kandachara department, headed by a Senapati or Dalavai who was a member of the cabinet.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p5
s: Where was Alluri Sitaramaraj killed by the British?
x: Alluri Sitaramaraju was captured at Madderu on 6 May 1924, killed at Koyyur and buried at Krishna Devi Peta.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p6
s: Who is the Secretary of the Home Rule League in Andhra?
x: Gadicharla Harisarvottama Rao was appointed Secretary of the Home Rule Movement in Andhra. B.N. Sharma presided over the Home Rule protests in Andhra.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p6
s: Naganika, who ruled South India as the guardian of the kingdom during the Satavahanas, was the queen of which of the following?
x: Devi Naganika, daughter of Maharathi Tranakairo, was the wife of Satakarni-I and ruled as guardian because his sons were minors. She issued the Nanaghat inscription after her husband's death.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p6
s: During the rule of the Satavahanas the kingdom was divided as follows for administrative convenience.
x: For administrative convenience the Satavahana kingdom was divided into Aharas, ruled by Amatyas.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p6
s: Who builds Pancharama's in Andhra?
x: Chalukya Bhima-I built the Pancharamas as famous Saiva kshetras: Amararamam, Ksheeraramam, Kumararamam, Draksharamam and Somaramam.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p6
s:
Arrange the following Vijayanagara rulers in chronological order.
i. Achyuta Devaraya
ii. Devaraya-II
iii. Venkatapati Raya-II
iv. Saluva Narasimha
x: The order is Devaraya-II (Sangama), Saluva Narasimha, Achyuta Devaraya and Venkatapati-II (Aravidu).

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p6
s: Who is the author of 'Sakala Neeti Sammatham'?
x: Sakalaneeti Sammatam, written by Madiki Singana, is one of the texts about the administration of the Kakatiyas.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p6
s: Which Kakatiya ruler started construction of Orugallu fort?
x: Rudradeva laid the foundation of the Orugallu fort, which was completed by Ganapatideva.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p6
s: Andhra Mahila Sabha was founded by?
x: Durgabai Deshmukh founded the Andhra Mahila Sabha in Madras in 1939. It was also established in Hyderabad in 1959.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p6
s: Who was the first Speaker of Andhra Pradesh State?
x: Ayyadevara Kaleswara Rao was the first Speaker of Andhra Pradesh state. The first Speaker of Andhra State was Nallapati Venkata Ramaiah.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p6
s: Who was the Bengali leader who promoted the "Vande Mataram Movement" in Andhra?
x: Bipin Chandra Pal visited Andhra in April 1907 on the invitation of Mutnuri Krishna Rao to spread the Vande Mataram movement.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p6
s: The Maharadhi Tranakairo was the father of which queen?
x: Devi Naganika, wife of Satakarni-I, was the daughter of Maharathi Tranakairo.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p6
s: Who wears the title of 'Sarvasiddhi'?
x: Kubja Vishnuvardhana, founder of the Eastern Chalukya kingdom, had titles such as Vishamasiddhi, Kamadeva and Makaradhwaja.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p6
s: Sangamayya cave is located in which district?
x: Sangamayya cave is located in Amadalavalasa town in Srikakulam district.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p6
s: Temples in Bhairavakona belong to the following religion?
x: The Bhairavakona temples in Prakasam district belong to Saivism; the group of 8 caves was built during the Vishnukundinas.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p6
s: After the victory in 1323 Delhi Sultans changed the name of Warangal to?
x: In 1323 Muhammad bin Tughlaq defeated Prataparudra-II and renamed Warangal as Sultanpur.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p7
s: In which of the following Buddhist settlements is the term 'Tambaya Dana' identified?
x: The term 'Tambaya Dana' is found at the Buddhist site of Kothur on the banks of the Sarada river near Elamanchili in Visakhapatnam district.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p7
s: Who described the description of Krishnadevaraya?
x: Domingo Paes describes Krishnadevaraya's body symmetry and facial expressions.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p7
s: The Bahmani-Vijayanagara conflict began during their time of?
x: The Bahmani kingdom was established during the reign of Harihara Raya-I and the Bahmani-Vijayanagara conflict seems to have started in 1356 AD.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p7
s: In which district of Andhra is the famous Ontimitta Rama temple?
x: Ontimitta, a famous Rama temple, is in present Annamayya district (formerly Kadapa).

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p7
s: The first widow marriage in Andhra was performed by the following?
x: Veereshalingam performed the first widow remarriage in Andhra on 11 December 1881, of Gogulapati Sriramulu and Seethamma.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p7
s: Roman coins have been found in different parts of Andhra during the period of the kingdoms mentioned below?
x: Roman coins found in different parts of Andhra are evidence of foreign trade during the Satavahana period.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p7
s: Nannaya wrote the 'Mahabharata' in Telugu in the following region.
x: Nannaya was the court poet of Eastern Chalukya king Rajaraja Narendra, whose capital was Rajamahendravaram, where the Mahabharata was written.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p7
s: Who among the following is not the son-in-law of Rudramadevi?
x: Rudramadevi's daughters were married to Annayya, Yellanadeva and Mahadevaraju. Recherla Prasaditya was one of her Nayankaras.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p7
s: Which of the following temples is famous for painting?
x: Lepakshi Veerabhadra temple of the Vijayanagara period is famous for its colourful paintings and has a large monolithic Basava sculpture.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p7
s: Andhra leaders signed the 'Sribagh pact' at the place mentioned below?
x: Sribagh was Kasinadhuni Nageswara Rao's house in Madras, where Andhra and Rayalaseema leaders met on 16 November 1937.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p7
s: The Vijayanagara Empire disappeared with this war
x: In the Battle of Topur (1616) Jaggaraya killed Sriranga Raya-II, and like Rakshasa Tangadi it damaged the prestige of the Vijayanagara Empire.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p7
s: Author of 'Prataparudra Yasobhushanam'?
x: The author of 'Prataparudra Yasobhushanam' is Vidyanatha.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p7
s: Which was the grandest festival celebrated by Vijayanagara kings every year?
x: Navaratri (Mahanavami/Dasara) was the most magnificent festival of the Vijayanagara era, as described by Domingo Paes.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p7
s: Magazine founded by Raghupathi Venkataratnam Naidu
x: Raghupathi Venkataratnam Naidu founded magazines like Brahma Prakashika, People's Friend and Fellow Worker.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p7
s: Which are the earliest inscriptions found in Andhra?
x: The history of the Andhras starts with Ashoka's inscriptions, found at Yerragudi, Rajula Mandagiri in Kurnool district and Amaravati.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p7
s: First railway line laid in Andhra in 1862?
x: The first railway line in Andhra was built in 1862 from Puttur to Renigunta.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p7
s: 'Arikamedu' is closest to which of the following places?
x: Arikamedu, a port city of the Satavahana period where foreign trade took place, was near Puducherry.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p8
s: During whose period the foreign ambassador of Persia, Abdul Razak, visited Vijayanagara?
x: Abdul Razak, ambassador from Persia, visited the Vijayanagara empire in 1443 during the reign of Devaraya-II.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p8
s: "Sara" was banned in Andhra Pradesh during which Chief Minister's term?
x: N.T. Rama Rao took oath as CM on 12 December 1994 and first signed a complete ban on alcohol. The anti-Sara movement was started by Roshamma in 1992 in Dubagunta village, Nellore district.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p8
s: Author of famous book "Vishvambhara"
x: C. Narayana Reddy (C.Na.Re.) received the Jnanpith Award in 1988 for Vishwambhara.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p8
s: Place of meeting of National Congress where National Flag was adopted?
x: The National Flag designed by Pingali Venkaiah was adopted with modifications at the All India Congress meeting held at Vijayawada on 31 March and 1 April 1921.
